emergency_numbers.label: Police
emergency_numbers.note_en: Operators may not speak English. State location first.

emergency_numbers.label: Fire & Ambulance
emergency_numbers.note_en: Say "kyūkyūsha" (きゅうきゅうしゃ) for ambulance. Operators may not speak English.

emergency_numbers.label: Japan Helpline — English 24/7
emergency_numbers.note_en: English-speaking operators. Can conference-translate with 110/119. Use this first.

emergency_numbers.label: AMDA Medical Info — English
emergency_numbers.note_en: Free multilingual medical phone line — helps find a doctor and can interpret. Mon–Fri 10:00–16:00, closed public holidays. Toll-free from a Japanese line: 0120-339-266.

embassy.address_jp: 〒102-0084 東京都千代田区二番町3
embassy.after_hours: Consular section direct line: 03-3264-0197. Closed on Israeli and Japanese holidays — during this trip that is Tue Nov 3 (Culture Day).

clinics.name_jp: 東京ステーションインターナショナルクリニック
clinics.address: 〒100-0005 東京都千代田区丸の内1-9-1 グランルーフ1F
clinics.hours: Every day 9:00–21:00, last reception 20:30 — Saturdays, Sundays and holidays included.
clinics.note: English-speaking doctors, set up for foreign patients. Walk in — people who booked online are seen first. Rapid flu test, about 30 min. Bring your passport; you pay yourself, by cash, card or e-money. The clinic's Access page shows how many people are waiting right now. The pin is the GranRoof building; the clinic is on its ground floor.
clinics.distance: JR Akihabara → Tokyo, 2 stops on the Yamanote or Keihin-Tōhoku line. Leave by the Yaesu South Exit; the clinic is 1 min away, next to the JR highway-bus terminal.

english_pharmacies.name: Ain Pharmacy, Tekko Building (アイン薬局 鉄鋼ビルディング地下1階)
english_pharmacies.location: Tekko Building B1F, Marunouchi 1-8-2 — ~500 m north of the clinic along the Yaesu side of Tokyo Station.
english_pharmacies.hours: Every day 9:00–21:00, Sundays and holidays included — the clinic's own hours.
english_pharmacies.note: Takes the clinic's prescription. English: everyday conversation, no need to warn them first. The pin is the Tekko Building.

english_pharmacies.name: Todokusuri Pharmacy (とどくすり薬局)
english_pharmacies.location: 8F, 燦坤日本電器ビル, Taitō 1-24-1 — ~600 m north-east of the hotel.
english_pharmacies.hours: Mon–Fri 10:00–22:00, Sat 10:00–13:00 & 14:00–19:00; closed Sun and holidays (Sun Oct 25 → use Ain above).
english_pharmacies.note: English: everyday conversation, no need to warn them first. Open until 22:00 on weekdays.

hospital.address: 〒101-8643 東京都千代田区神田和泉町1
hospital.note: Phone before you go — the hospital asks every emergency patient to call first, and may be at capacity. ¥8,800 off-hours surcharge, waived if they judge you need treatment. English help finding a doctor: Tokyo Himawari 03-5285-8181, daily 9:00–20:00. Nurse advice line: #7119 / 03-3212-2323, 24h.
hospital.hours: Emergency reception 24h — at night, internal medicine and surgery only. Outpatient Mon–Fri 9:00–17:00, Sat 9:00–12:30; closed Sun & holidays.
hospital.distance: 7 min walk from JR Akihabara Showa-dori exit — the hotel is 1 min from the same station.

pharmacy.name: Welcia Akihabara Ekimae (ウエルシア秋葉原駅前店)
pharmacy.location: BiTO AKIBA 1F, Sotokanda 1-18-19 — at Akihabara Station, Electric Town exit side.
pharmacy.hours: Store open 24 hours. Dispensing counter Mon–Sat 9:00–21:00, Sun 10:00–14:00 & 15:00–19:00; closed public holidays.
pharmacy.note: Outside those dispensing hours it is over-the-counter only. English: a few words, and they ask to be warned first — for an English conversation use the two above.

clinics.name_jp: ドクターカミング インターナショナルクリニック京都ステーション
clinics.address: 〒600-8216 京都市下京区東塩小路町901 ホテルグランヴィア京都 6F
clinics.hours: Every day, holidays included: 9:00–13:00 & 14:00–18:00. Last registration 12:00 / 17:00.
clinics.note: English-speaking doctor; walk in. Send your details first on WhatsApp or the web form and you are seen first. Flat ¥65,000: consultation, the tests the doctor decides on, and medicine handed over at the clinic (usually — otherwise a prescription for a nearby pharmacy). They quote anything extra before doing it. Bring your passport; card or cash. The pin is Hotel Granvia; the clinic is on its 6th floor.
clinics.distance: Inside Hotel Granvia Kyoto, the hotel built into JR Kyoto Station — reached from the station without going outside.

clinics.name_en: Kurita Internal Medicine & Endoscopy Clinic — the cheaper option
clinics.name_jp: くりた内科・内視鏡クリニック
clinics.address: 〒600-8383 京都市下京区綾大宮町62 シェルブリュー四条大宮1階
clinics.hours: Reception Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri 8:45–11:45 & 15:45–17:45; Sat 8:45–11:45. Closed Thu, Sun and holidays — on your dates shut Oct 29, Nov 1, Nov 3 and Nov 5.
clinics.note: ¥22,000 consultation plus tests; the clinic's stated typical total is ¥30,000–50,000. Basic English with the doctor. Walk-ins are taken when they have room — book on the 24-hour web form or by email (kurita.clinic62@gmail.com) to be sure. Bring your passport. The prescription goes to a pharmacy: Shijō-Ōmiya Pharmacy is next door. The pin sits on Ōmiya-dōri at the building.
clinics.distance: Taxi from the Kyoto Station Karasuma-exit rank, 10–11 min. Or 2 min on foot from Hankyū / Randen Shijō-Ōmiya.

english_pharmacies.name: Matsui Pharmacy (松井薬局)
english_pharmacies.location: Shichijō-dōri, Zaimokuchō 478 — ~260 m north-east of the hotel.
english_pharmacies.hours: Mon–Fri 9:00–20:00, Sat 9:00–18:00; closed Sun and holidays.
english_pharmacies.note: English: everyday conversation, no need to warn them first. Dr.coming usually hands over its own medicine; this is for anything else.

hospital.address: 〒600-8558 京都市下京区塩小路通西洞院東入東塩小路町841-5
hospital.note: Call the emergency line 075-361-1351 — not 075-361-1360, which is appointments only, weekdays 9:00–17:00. The hospital's own site runs in English, Chinese and Korean. Nurse advice line: #7119 / 0570-00-7119, 24h, free. ⚠ Kyoto City's after-hours clinic at Nijō has no adult internal medicine on weekday nights, so this hospital is the first call.
hospital.hours: Emergency reception 24h (internal medicine, surgery, cardiology, neurosurgery). Outpatient 9:00–12:30 & 14:00–16:00; closed Sun & holidays.
hospital.distance: Kyoto Station Central Exit — the hospital's own directions walk you there from the same gate the hotel uses, past the Central Post Office.

pharmacy.name: Kokumin Drug, Kyoto Porta (コクミンドラッグ 京都ポルタ店)
pharmacy.location: Kyoto Porta B1F — the underground mall on Kyoto Station's north side, the hotel's own side.
pharmacy.hours: Shop 7:00–22:30 daily. Dispensing counter Mon–Fri 9:00–14:00 & 15:00–20:00, Sat 9:00–14:00 & 15:00–18:00; closed Sun & holidays.
pharmacy.note: Over-the-counter medicine is available across the whole 7:00–22:30 window. The map pin drops on Porta itself — B1F is one connected level and the drugstore zone is signposted from every entrance.

clinics.name_en: Hiroshima International Clinic (Hiroshima Hatchōbori Internal Medicine & GI Endoscopy Clinic)
clinics.name_jp: 広島八丁堀内科・胃腸内視鏡クリニック
clinics.address: 〒730-0013 広島市中区八丁堀11-19 坪井第二ビル3階
clinics.hours: Walk-in reception every day 9:00–11:45, Saturday and Sunday included. 12:00–15:00 is booked appointments only. Weekdays also 14:45–17:45. Closed on public holidays — none fall on Nov 7–9.
clinics.note: Sees travellers without Japanese insurance; multilingual staff or a translation app. Fever, cough and sore throat are on its list. Bring your passport. Consultation ¥16,500; flu and COVID test ¥5,500 each; English medical certificate ¥11,000. Cash or card. You leave with a prescription and they point you to a partner pharmacy nearby. To ask for a 12:00–15:00 slot, use the contact form on the English site. 3rd floor; the pin is the building.
clinics.distance: Tram from JR Hiroshima Station on the line towards Kamiyachō (the hospital's tram, below) — get off at Hatchōbori, 2 min on foot.

english_pharmacies.name: Kōjin Pharmacy, Socio Kamiyachō (康仁薬局 ソシオ紙屋町店)
english_pharmacies.location: Socio Square Kamiyachō Building 1F, Kamiyachō 2-3-20 — ~600 m west of the clinic.
english_pharmacies.hours: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 9:00–19:00; Wed 9:00–18:30; Sat 9:00–18:00; closed Sun and holidays.
english_pharmacies.note: English: everyday conversation, no need to warn them first. Sat Nov 7 and Mon Nov 9.

english_pharmacies.name: Cosmos Pharmacy, Kamiyachō (コスモス薬局 紙屋町二丁目)
english_pharmacies.location: Kamiyachō 2-2-6 — ~500 m west of the clinic, ~100 m from Kōjin.
english_pharmacies.hours: Sun and holidays 11:00–18:00. Mon–Fri 9:00–19:00 (Wed to 18:30), Sat 9:00–18:00.
english_pharmacies.note: The Sunday answer for Nov 8: the clinic's walk-in window ends 11:45 and this opens 11:00. English: a few words only, no need to warn them first.

hospital.name_jp: 広島市立広島市民病院
hospital.note: Outside opening hours, report to the emergency reception in the East Building, 1F. Nurse advice line: #7119 / 082-246-2000, 24h. For an evening illness there is also Senda-machi Night Emergency Centre (千田町夜間急病センター), 082-504-9990, reception 19:30–22:30 daily, adults 15+ — they require you to phone before coming. ⚠ The hospital nearest the hotel, Futaba-no-sato (5 min from the Shinkansen exit), runs outpatient clinics Mon–Fri only, so it is shut on both nights of this stay.
hospital.distance: Tram from JR Hiroshima Station, ~16 min to Kamiyachō-higashi, then ~7 min on foot; the hotel is 3 min from the station's south exit. ⚠ Last tram from the station is 22:01 (line 1) / 22:31 (line 2) — later than that, take a taxi from the station rank and show the address above.

pharmacy.name: Matsumoto Kiyoshi, ekie (マツモトキヨシ エキエ広島店)
pharmacy.location: ekie 1F, inside Hiroshima Station on the south side — behind the same South Exit the hotel lists as a 3 min walk.
pharmacy.note: The map pin drops on the ekie mall inside the station, not on the shop front.

show_to_staff_cards.en: Please help, please call an ambulance
show_to_staff_cards.jp: 助けてください、救急車を呼んでください
show_to_staff_cards.romaji: tasukete kudasai, kyūkyūsha wo yonde kudasai

show_to_staff_cards.en: I don't speak Japanese. Is there someone who speaks English?
show_to_staff_cards.jp: 日本語が話せません。英語を話せる方はいますか？
show_to_staff_cards.romaji: nihongo ga hanasemasen. eigo wo hanaseru kata wa imasu ka?

show_to_staff_cards.en: I feel sick. I want to go to a hospital.
show_to_staff_cards.jp: 具合が悪いです。病院に行きたいです。
show_to_staff_cards.romaji: guai ga warui desu. byōin ni ikitai desu.

show_to_staff_cards.en: I'm staying here. I want to return to my hotel.
show_to_staff_cards.jp: ここに泊まっています。ホテルに戻りたいです。
show_to_staff_cards.romaji: koko ni tomatte imasu. hoteru ni modoritai desu.

show_to_staff_cards.en: I'm lost. I want to go to this place. [show your Maps screen]
show_to_staff_cards.jp: 道に迷いました。この場所に行きたいです。
show_to_staff_cards.romaji: michi ni mayoimashita. kono basho ni ikitai desu.

show_to_staff_cards.jp: 警察を呼んでください

pharmacy_tip: Japanese pharmacies (ドラッグストア) sell OTC painkillers, cold medicine, bandages, and stomach remedies. Prescription medicine — flu antivirals included — needs a Japanese doctor's prescription: the walk-in clinic for each city, above, writes one. Show the pharmacist what's wrong — many understand basic English medical terms.
